text:
anya: Quick flag from the monthly RBAC sweep - found 3 principals with roles/cloudkms.admin on prod that haven't touched keys in >120d. Starting SEC-6321 to track.

ops-oncall: can you list them and the query you used?

anya: redacted list:
- serviceAccount:old-bridge@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com
- user:contractor-lucy@example.com
- group:infra-legacy-admins@redwood.com

anya: query for reproducibility:
```bash
gcloud projects get-iam-policy redwood-prod --format=json | jq '.bindings[] | select(.role=="roles/cloudkms.admin")'
```

ryan: i'll run a BigQuery to show last 365d of KMS calls by principal and attach to SEC-6321.

ops-oncall: plan: 1) collect owner + last-call evidence, 2) snapshot pre-policy to GCS, 3) dry-run revoke, 4) canary revoke in MW with 48h rollback window, 5) post-snapshot and finalize.

compliance: reminder: attach HR confirmation for contractors before removal and tag snapshots with ticket id.

audit-bot: snapshot scheduled: gs://redwood-audit/iam-snapshots/3180007777-pre.json. log export job queued.

anya: thanks. i'll update SEC-6321 with the BigQuery output and owner notes. ops-oncall, please wait for attachments before any change. :white_check_mark:
